scope: Independent final Stage14 visual review of actual rendered gameplay; no browser or runtime edit. Extracted contact sheets are cropped original-size gameplay video samples, not generated artwork.
captureVersionDisclosure: Final clean Stage14 capture after startup, metadata and recorder-shutdown cleanup. Earlier pre-metadata and recorder-shutdown attempts are separately labelled and excluded from clean delivery.

motionReview.method: Decoded entire VP9 clip without ffmpeg errors, then independently inspected2samples/second across full clip as unscaled240x260actorcrops. Compared equivalent sampling of Stage13 baseline.

findings: Both new whole-parent viewing angles remain visibly distinct in both facing mirrors and after stopping/diagonal release.
Alternating boots and slight outward swing-knee bend are visible without the earlier duplicate third leg/boot strip, broad sideways knee splay or obvious joint separation in reviewed frames.
Added body support motion is restrained; original baby face/neck/clothing and lower legs/shoes remain continuous, readable, attached and at accepted normal scale.
Source-side walk remains visually consistent; foot shadows stay on the floor and the one parked player bike remains outside.
This is an incremental improvement to articulated painted pieces, not a fully drawn walking frame sequence.
limitations: Two recordings follow the same scripted path with different input/phase timestamps, so contact sheets are not a pixel-aligned before/after animation metric.
No physical-device/Safari/thermal test or frame-time claim from this visual review.
Final input, timing, cross-engine and clean-package results belong to their separate evidence.
